title: Vol'dun and Sethraliss
summary: Exile, Jakra'zet's secret plans, sethrak divisions, and the endangered Temple of Sethraliss shape the desert's campaign.
opening: Vol'dun was treated as a place of banishment, yet many peoples built lives there. General Jakra'zet's designs threatened them and the wider Zandalari realm.
reviewNote: Check the zone and dungeon quest order; do not overstate a settled political outcome.
